hooks.name: Post-task verify
hooks.description: A task is only complete when the invariants hold: typecheck, lint, every property suite, and the Playwright pixel scan of every route in all three luminance modes. A post-task hook cannot block, so a red result is reported loudly and the Stop gate is what refuses completion.

action.command: { pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && (cd apps/mobile && pnpm build >/dev/null && pnpm exec playwright test pixel-scan); } >/tmp/afterglow-post-task.log 2>&1 || { echo 'post-task-verify: an invariant is RED after this task. Fix it before the next task.' >&2; tail -30 /tmp/afterglow-post-task.log >&2; exit 1; }
